errors.evidence: The description states that the pie chart has four sectors, but the image clearly shows five sectors. The sectors are 'Да, напълно' (17%), 'По-скоро да' (35%), 'Не мога да преценя' (35%), 'По-скоро не' (9%), and 'Не, изобщо' (4%).

The color of the 'По-скоро не' sector is described as 'blue-grey' ('синьо-сиво'). In the chart, this sector is colored dark blue, while another sector is grey. Describing it as blue-grey is imprecise.
